newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia opens sharply up in Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Nokia opens sharply up in Helsinki.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy opened sharply up in Helsinki, tracking overnight gains in New York which were fuelled by rumours it would merge with its Swedish rival Ericsson, brokers said.
At 1030/0830 GMT Nokia started up 9.00 markka or over three percent at 264.00, about level with the close of its ADRs in New York. It later dipped to 262.50 markka.
"It's the rumours that are moving it," said one broker, adding he did not believe them and that he expected the price to ease. -- Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 242
